# Dāwîḏ walks into a faith & spiritual organizations firm

Walk into any faith & spiritual organizations outfit and watch for ten minutes. You will see a very old act performed with newer props. The act has a name. It is **Dāwîḏ**.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Anointed in Secret.** The prophet Samuel is sent to Bethlehem to anoint a new king from among Jesse's sons.  One by one the tall and impressive brothers pass by, but YHWH rejects them.  The youngest, David, is kept in the fields tending sheep.

**David and Goliath.** The Philistine champion Goliath challenges Israel to single combat.  David, still a boy, refuses Saul's armor and goes out with a staff, a sling, and five stones.  'You come to me with a sword and with a spear,' he says, 'but I come to you in the name of the LORD of hosts.

## The Reveal, Seat by Seat

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*The shepherd-king and sweet psalmist of Israel; the Psalter carries his name and Jerusalem carries his city.* The match is not poetic license. Strip the trade to its function and the function is the myth.

### Leadership, Governance & Public Administration

Now read the why-line with the office in mind: *The model king; statecraft with a harp and a sling.* The people doing this work did not borrow the archetype. They re-derived it — the way Dāwîḏ was always going to be re-derived wherever king, psalmist matters.

### Music, Arts & Performance

*The harp-playing psalmist king.* Nobody in that trade worships at this temple. They just keep its hours.

### Writing, Publishing & Media

*The psalmist; devotional publishing’s bestselling voice.* The match is not poetic license. Strip the trade to its function and the function is the myth.

## Not the First Rebrand

In Islam, David is Dāwūd, a prophet-king who received the Zabūr (Psalms), could soften iron, and was granted a wise judgment.  Christianity reads David as the ancestor of Jesus and the model of the messianic king; the Gospels open with his genealogy and the Psalms with his voice. The office is only the latest translation.
